plainEnglish.summary: An organisational assertion: the organisation states that it identified the places where users make substantial decisions about money, privacy or wellbeing, and added support there - a clear layout of advantages and disadvantages, comprehension aids such as icons and graphics, and reduced distractions.
plainEnglish.whyItMatters: High-stakes decisions are where poor comprehension turns into real harm. Extra support at those points protects people with cognitive disabilities from consequences that are hard to reverse.
